evidence: No reward inversion was demonstrated, but required empirical app ranking remains unmeasured. The frozen workbook Quality Checks row 43 (quality #42) and Internal Quality Checks E43 require monitoring ordering; qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md:31 requires a separate hash-bound reward-ordering runtime record. runtime-evidence.json is absent, and raw-evidence-index.json explicitly says configured app reward discrimination/ranking is absent. Index SHA256 4df30797f063a8b5373cdc0749b01caadaeec4c0df5a75faf1241a02704ae3d9: all 317 listed artifact hashes matched; exact checks are saved in per-row-review/evidence/42/index-hash-checks.json. Structural evidence is favorable: frozen task tests/scoring.toml:1-11 is byte-identical to the frozen template, with zero-mass gates and positive 0.6/0.2/0.2 weights. tests/tools/score.py:40-48 is also template-identical: gates and the strict F>0.05 floor precede the rounded weighted score. Every criterion weight is positive (functional 145 criteria/45 total weight, polish 5/9, visual 5/6). Thus improving a fixed observed criterion/dimension vector cannot lower its calculated reward. Actual execution of the unchanged scorer via python -B per-row-review/evidence/42/score-probe.py tested 252 synthetic vectors, including both gates and the floor boundary, with 804 adjacent input-improvement comparisons and zero inversions; score-probe.json SHA256 d4f1711c939399c84648a76cf4e8800b2ca68f558d51c784ec47c0cc59c1d8b1. These are synthetic inputs, not measured app scores. Semantic safeguards: gate constraints judge.toml:23-26 requires UI creation and independent-context retrieval rather than advanced settlement; functional prompt.md:9-19 preserves independent outcomes and alternative setups; visual prompt.md:8-12 allows empty collections, free layouts and independent visual anchors. Local/gate-witness/results.json (SHA256 fd8410bc91102874ef98edfdbacf19f7853687956e076acc684d36c565d9ec75), verified against its script, shows dead approval still satisfies basic storage observations while a no-op creation does not. Local/batch-witnesses/results.json (SHA256 477ba650c81ce00e5d6346f679b774f23c5a197b78b346bb183e7eb0a70bcf83), its mutation script and raw per-variant results detect selected ABA/retry/netting defects and accept the optional empty operational seed. The script stops each mutant at its first failure, so passing-group counts cannot establish full reward ordering. Local/configured-inspection/results.json (SHA256 68a8e192fc287fa192052ca0c74eccdcda93ba0d28f440641f0ef8337825db57) identifies itself as parser/CLI-construction evidence with NO provider grade; all its cited test hashes match this snapshot. No full configured golden-versus-weaker-app rewards, judge completion measurements, Oracle, model or portal score are inferred. Runtime scope is PARTIAL: scorer arithmetic and selected product observations were exercised; configured app ordering was not. No new Docker/provider work, source mutation, shared policy change or timeout change was performed.
counterexample: Broken alternatives inspected: balance_only_version accepts a preview after a touched-budget ABA change (200 rather than required 409); no_cached_receipt returns 409 rather than the original success on an identical retry; sequential_budget rejects an affordable fully funded cycle. The current functional criteria own those failures (hro_change_aba, hro_change_retry_concurrent, hro_change_net_budget), but no configured reward comparison establishes that these apps score below the golden. Conforming alternative inspected: an app omitting optional operational demonstration history, expressly allowed by instruction.md:11 and functional prompt.md:23, passes the same 15 scripted batch groups. The gate and optional DRAFT criterion accommodate it; no conforming-app false-fail or actual ranking inversion was demonstrated.
suggested_fix: Supply authorized, current-input-hash-bound configured grader runs for the golden, controlled weaker variants and the conforming empty-operational-seed alternative; retain per-criterion results, full logs and final rewards in the required reward_ranking_is_monotone runtime record, then assess observed ordering without changing the canonical score policy or treating synthetic/group-count evidence as app grades.
